Name: Lance of The First Slash (Stardew Druid)
Author: neosinf
Description:
===========================================
Stardew Druid: Lance of The First Slash
===========================================

Lance wants to hunt monsters and save lives, will you help him?

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to enable recruitment of the Lance character (unlocked during a Stardew Valley Expanded mod playthrough) when using the Recruit Hero effect.

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'heroic crossovers' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.[/color]

This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

Check out heroes from other crossover mods here!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32958]Sophia, Blue Moon Avenger
[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32565]Sevinae of Alchemistry[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32396]Astarion of Baldur's Village[/url]﻿

------------------------------------
Future development
------------------------------------

Not sure, I might be able to do more with this mod based on feedback from players and the SVE team.

------------------------------------
Lance looks slightly different
------------------------------------

That's because this is my artistic vision for Lance based on recreating the original sprite sheet in the style that suits the Stardew Druid character model.

------------------------------------
How do I recruit Lance?
------------------------------------

If you're familiar with Stardew Druid, and you've unlocked the Gift of the Heiress in your playthrough, then you'll know what to do, just cast Rite of Mists: Smite on Lance when you see him onscreen. Once you see the 'Lance has been added to the ledger of recruits' notice, go to the Stardew Druid journal, press the lightning sword icon to open the ledger menu, click on Lance's entry, then click the check box to summon him.

If you are not interested in a Druid playthrough, you can use the set progress feature in the Stardew Druid configuration to skip right to the Gift of the Heiress unlock, which is progress 30.

Alternatively, the recruit system is immediately available for Magic only mode users of Stardew Druid (either by setting in config or by using the Magic By Neosinf mod).
